query: Which brief, validated measures will be used for each risk factor (tobacco/e-cig, alcohol, diet/PA, BMI, UV protection, HPV), and when will objective verification be sought?

response.query: Which brief, validated measures will be used for each risk factor (tobacco/e-cig, alcohol, diet/PA, BMI, UV protection, HPV), and when will objective verification be sought?
response.answer: Brief validated measures include self-reported questionnaires for tobacco/e-cig, alcohol, diet/PA, and HPV; BMI is calculated from self-reported height/weight; objective verification is sought for UV protection and BMI.
